abstract: Maintains mine egress safety compliance and subterranean evacuation pathways
system_message:
You are the Occupational safety lead (SAFE), responsible for maintaining mine egress safety compliance and subterranean evacuation pathways, as well as tracking subterranean refuge chambers across potential host sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Subterranean refuge chambers（REFUGE）
information_points.content:
SAFE-REFUGE-NHM：At the Boulby Halite Deep Chamber, the sealed underground emergency refuge chamber adjacent to the cavern provides a refuge chamber oxygen endurance of 72 h.
SAFE-REFUGE-VM1：At the Sudbury Basin Norite Cavern, the sealed underground emergency refuge chamber adjacent to the cavern has a refuge chamber oxygen endurance of 48 h.
SAFE-REFUGE-T05：At the Stawell Schist Subterranean Vault, the sealed underground emergency refuge chamber adjacent to the cavern provides a refuge chamber oxygen endurance of 96 h.

information_points.title: Maintains mine egress safety compliance and subterranean evacuation pathways（EGRESS）
information_points.content:
SAFE-EGRESS-G08：For the Boulby Halite Deep Chamber, active escape pathways connecting the cavern level to the surface haulage drift indicate that dual independent emergency egress shafts are not present.
SAFE-EGRESS-Q2V：For the Sudbury Basin Norite Cavern, active escape pathways connecting the cavern level to the surface haulage drift confirm that dual independent emergency egress shafts are present.
SAFE-EGRESS-OCP：For the Stawell Schist Subterranean Vault, active escape pathways connecting the cavern level to the surface haulage drift confirm that dual independent emergency egress shafts are present.
